ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
PORTRAITS & LIGHT

STUDY 042
Fur-Collar Beret & Dark Turtleneck
Rights check
Source: 24381.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with shoulder-length straight
blonde hair wears a black sequined beret and a warm
taupe ribbed turtleneck. A black fur-collared coat
frames her shoulders, and small drop earrings catch
the light. Her expression is serious, with her gaze
looking off into the distance. A blurred winter street with
passersby in the background, bright sunlight. Palette of
black, taupe, and soft cream. Classic and moody, in the
style of a 1990s film still.
Classic, moody, wintry
WORKING NOTES
- The sequined beret and taupe turtleneck are the key
styling.
- Add 'shallow depth of field' to keep the crowd soft.
